messages:
Alex M: quick heads-up — noticed p99 token latency spikes on /generate-route and /embed-route after the kernel selector rollout. suspecting kernel fallback + cold KV cache combos. sharing a tiny trace and metric names we used.
Priya Nair: can you paste the logs and a short breakdown?
Alex M: sure — sample log snippet from staging: 
```log
[2026-03-10T14:11:02Z] route=/generate-route request_id=abc123 kernel=triton_v2 fallback=true kv_cache_hit=false token_index=24 token_latency_ms=12.3
[2026-03-10T14:11:02Z] route=/generate-route request_id=abc124 kernel=triton_v1 fallback=false kv_cache_hit=true token_index=1 token_latency_ms=2.1
```
Alex M: metrics in play: `token_latency.ms` (labels: route,kernel_choice,kv_hit,component), `kernel_selection.count`, `kv_cache.hit_rate`, `batch.size_histogram`, `route.errors`.
Marco Li: interesting — fallback kernels + kv misses make sense. do you have a breakdown of p99 attribution (kernel vs kv vs queue)?
Alex M: quick slice: for the last 48h on /generate-route: extra p99 overhead (above baseline) ~= 100ms. of that, ~62% tracked to `kv_cache_hit=false` tokens, ~28% to `kernel=fallback` tokens, rest is queue/decode. so KV misses are the biggest offender.
Jen Ortiz: for Console I recommend a compact per-route panel: stacked token-level waterfall with components [kernel_ms, kv_ms, queue_ms, decode_ms] plus p50/p95/p99 numbers and throughput+error sparklines. add a kernel_choice filter and a small sample-traces table (1-5 rows) linking to the profiler.
Priya Nair: sampling proposal: 1/200 requests capture full token timeline + kernel_choice history + batch context. emit `token_latency_components.ms` with `component` tag (kernel|kv|queue|decode) so dashboards can stack.
perf-bot: automated profile summary: hot_kernels=[triton_v1,triton_v2]; fallback_overhead.median=4.8ms/token; kv_miss_penalty.median=8.9ms/token; 48h kernel_fallback_rate=3.7%; kv_miss_rate=2.4% (routes skewed).
Marco Li: action items I'd take: (1) add `token_latency_components.ms` and `kernel_choice` labels (2) dashboard PR with stacked waterfall + kernel filter + sample traces (3) tweaking batcher heuristics: for short sequences prefer stable kernels even if slightly higher median to lower p99.
Alex M: I'll open the dashboard PR and add the metric instrumentation change on staging. tagging @Jen Ortiz and @Priya Nair for UX/metrics review :point_up: 
Jen Ortiz: great — can you prototype panels with two weeks of sampled data? that gives enough p99 signals.
Alex M: last bit: propose alerts: route p99 > 120ms for 5m -> paging; route p99 > 80ms -> warning. also warn if kernel_fallback_rate > 5% for 10m.
Priya Nair: +1 to paging on >120ms. also +1 to kernel_fallback warning. add a non-paging channel message at 80-120ms so product owners see it.
Alex M: cool — I'll write up a short RFC with dashboard mocks, metrics PR, and the batching experiment plan. will assign owners and ETA next week.
Priya Nair: thanks — if we can get a prototype in staging this week we can validate sampling overhead.
Alex M: ack. will follow up with PR links and staging dashboard URL.
